The '''MMV security droid''' was a series of tracked [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] used by [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

A number of these droids were sent to ORO mines in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Some of these, including [[MMV-608]], were still active five centuries later.
